versions.subject: feat: add VMwareToolBoxCmd persistence
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\VMwareToolBoxCmd.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'toolbox-cmd.exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' script '
        - ' set '
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\VMwareToolBoxCmd.exe" OR OriginalFileName="toolbox-cmd.exe" CommandLine="* script *" CommandLine="* set *"
